entries.262b2fde1cc55172: Investment partnership formed in June 2025. Consolidated subsidiary directX Ventures Co., Ltd. contributes capital and executes operations as a limited liability partner.
entries.5c0af29c53123215: A company that provides DX services supporting operational efficiency for businesses with field sites, such as the construction industry, centered on the field-oriented business chat "direct."
entries.73ea51a2d474001d: Consolidated subsidiary headquartered in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. Established in April 2025 to engage in startup investment.
entries.86c0e9751c2863db: Consolidated subsidiary headquartered in Nishi-ku, Osaka, Osaka Prefecture. It provides solutions using BIM (a system that visualizes and manages a building's three-dimensional model with added information such as materials, performance, cost and construction schedule). It acquired all shares in October 2025 and became a subsidiary. For the fiscal year ended December 2025, only the balance sheet is included in consolidation, and its contribution to revenue is expected from the fiscal year ending December 2026.
entries.a0ae6860a1978c37: Business that centrally offers “direct,” a business chat for field sites, and integrated solutions such as “direct Apps,” “Tagshot / Tag Album,” “knowledge videos” and “AI-FAQ bot,” provided in SaaS form. It also undertakes DX consulting, system development on commission and BIM solutions; its consolidated subsidiary Shisutemu Emuzu Co., Ltd. handles development on commission and infrastructure construction, and IU BIM STUDIO Co., Ltd. handles BIM solutions. “direct” is also offered as “LoGo chat,” a business chat for local governments, through OEM supply to Torasutobanku Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,132 million, consisting of stock revenue of ¥1,768 million and professional services and other revenue of ¥364 million.
